content: Rather than hand-crafted language features, we have taken an "end to end" approach building from the raw text to a final model that achieves the tasks as presented. Our paper lays out the details of the system and our code can be found in a GitHub repository for use by other researchers to extend the state of the art in sentiment analysis.
